podcast.title: Breakaway (1966) - Experimental Film
podcast.body: Bruce Conner, an American underground artist, created a short film titled "Breakaway" in 1966. This experimental piece featured future MTV star Toni Basil performing a strip tease set to a song, demonstrating early artistic exploration of visual music concepts. "He had a short film called Breakway which featured future MTV star Tony Basel, number her and Mickey, performing a strip tease to a song sheet written that was 1966."
